g.text: Sweden Central · three /16 address spaces that must not overlap
both names are reserved by Azure
each link is two objects: hub-to-dev + dev-to-hub, hub-to-prod + prod-to-hub
dev and prod cannot reach each other through the hub
spoke-to-spoke needs a direct peering, or a hub NVA / Azure Firewall plus UDRs
az CLI — one peering object per direction, so you create it twice
# then the mirror: dev-to-hub, swapping rg / vnet / remote
peering properties once both directions exist
